title: A software business has several rails, not one sales funnel.
subtitle: The same customer promise has to survive every handoff.
items: Which channel brings people with this job now?
What useful event tells us it worked?
Does this job actually recur? At what cadence?
Does price cover delivery, AI usage and support?
Can people correct, leave and recover their work?
What bottleneck needs a person or a system next?

title: Choose the selling motion after you understand the job.
subtitle: None of these is automatically the mature version of another.
items: Fits a job users can try and understand themselves.
Loses when setup, risk or judgment needs human help.
Human help to reach a useful deployment
Fits a valuable, complicated purchase where price can fund sales.
Loses when every small purchase needs a long call.
People deliver important parts of the outcome
Fits early learning or jobs needing real human support.
Loses when marketed as scalable software while delivery stays bespoke.
A bounded outcome with a finish line
Fits a decision or project that legitimately ends.
Loses when ongoing value and frequent repeat use are actually the job.

title: Build the smallest reliable loop before a platform.
subtitle: Proposed operating checklist, not a universal technology stack.
items: Only collect what this job needs
Explain use of sensitive information and who can see it.
Do not add contact scraping or surprise social accountability.
Save progress; handle incomplete inputs and corrections.
Do not confuse a chat response with a completed customer job.
Track source, first useful event, repeat event and payment status.
Avoid logging private conversations as analytics payloads.
Handle receipts, failed payments, cancellation and deletion requests.
Do not begin with hidden renewals or unsupported outcome guarantees.
Test broken states; keep a human escalation path.
No need for elaborate infrastructure before a small pilot.
Test representative cases, uncertain advice, harmful outputs and cost caps.
A stronger model does not by itself establish coaching quality.
